name: Video Resolution Downscaling
summary: Scales high-resolution video (e.g. 4K to 1080p or 1080p to 720p) to immediately cut pixel count in half or quarter.
analogy: Printing a giant poster as a postcard so it fits in a small envelope.
what_you_gain: Immediate 60-80% file size reduction before video codec compression even begins.
what_you_lose: Fine details visible on 4K monitors (small text, distant faces) become softer.
best_for: Archiving oversized 4K phone recordings or screen recordings meant for mobile viewing.
avoid_for: Video containing tiny crisp text or critical high-precision visual data.
go_deeper: Uses bicubic / Lanczos resampling spatial filter kernels to compute interpolated pixel values across downscaled grid coordinates.
